newsitem.title: USA: Duke confirms Oconee nuke restart Friday.
newsitem.headline: Duke confirms Oconee nuke restart Friday.

text.p: Duke Power Co said Friday its 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 3 nuclear unit would likely restart sometime today after tripping off line Thursday.

"We anticipate that unit being brought back today. It will probably reach full power sometime this weekend. It tripped yesterday during the testing of the control rod drive system. We had an electrical short," company spokeswoman Guynn Savage said.
On Thursday, the unit, in Seneca, S.C., was in the process of increasing power from its maintenance outage which began last October.
The company also reported that its 1,129 MW Catawba 2 nuclear unit, in Clover, S.C., would go off line today for a 40-50 day refueling outage.
